findings.title: Avoid uncharged quadratic lookup during immutable report traversal
findings.observed: Both ReportBudget.check and _freeze use mapping.items() for exact JsonObject values. Mapping.items retrieves each value through JsonObject.__getitem__, whose retained public mapping implementation searches members linearly. The new caller therefore performs n(n+1)/2 comparisons per pass.
findings.reproduction: For one 64-member immutable object, document_bytes=65536 and artifact_records=4, ReportBudget.check succeeds after 2080 key comparisons while charging 129 nodes and zero of its 256 work units. bounded_object repeats the lookup traversal and performs 4160 comparisons. The 16/32/64-member probe uses actual line-event comparison counts, with no elapsed-time assertion.
findings.impact: Wide valid report objects can perform quadratic unreserved work before encoding even though their byte, depth and node reservations pass. Construction and Markdown budget checks expose the same new caller pattern.
findings.required_change: Iterate the exact immutable JsonObject.members pairs directly, while retaining dict.items for exact dictionaries and the current preallocation/shape checks. Keep the accepted models.py API unchanged. Add a small counted regression showing no keyed lookup during immutable budget/freeze traversal, preserving output identity and rejection semantics.
